high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from an article or news piece about the "Dragon Ball" franchise. The top part of the image features a dynamic illustration of two characters engaged in a physical confrontation. One character has spiky yellow hair and is wearing a blue outfit with a black armband on his left arm. He appears to be in a powerful stance, with clenched fists and an intense expression, suggesting he is in the middle of a battle. The other character, partially obscured by the first, seems to be struggling against him.
